name: Ringmaster Cato
title: The Grand Ring
examine: Half his face is old scar and all of it is showman. He counts the crowd the way a banker counts coin, and the sand the way a farmer counts weather.
lines: Seats are free. Standing on the sand costs.
I fought nineteen cards on sand worse than this. The twentieth taught me to sell tickets instead.
The crowd forgets a win in a week. A good LOSS they talk about all winter.
